title: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
content: The software does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users. When an application includes untrusted data in an HTTP response without proper validation or encoding, a web browser cannot determine that the script is untrusted and executes it in the user's browser context. This allows attackers to execute malicious scripts, hijack sessions, deface web pages, or redirect users. Remediation requires context-aware contextual output encoding (HTML body, attributes, JavaScript contexts), input sanitization against safe allowlists, and deployment of a strong Content-Security-Policy (CSP).

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
